{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Ubote 3''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] in the service of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It fought at the [[Defense of Outpost D-34|First Battle of Javin]] as part of the [[Ubote group|''Ubote'' group]], along with ''[[Ubote 1]]'' and ''[[Ubote 2]]''.<ref name="tf">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>
